title: Livin' on a Prayer
headline: The first 'Livin' on a Prayer' lives on a hidden track
caption:
Hugh McDonald, who played the uncredited bassline on the Slippery When Wet take, had been on Jon's records before. He was one of the studio musicians on 'Runaway', the demo a local radio DJ put on a compilation of homegrown talent before Bon Jovi was a band.

In 1994 he replaced Alec John Such, first as a touring and session player. He became a full member in 2016, three decades after playing on the band's signature song without his name on it.

🎧 The song: "Livin' on a Prayer" by Bon Jovi (@bonjovi)
